questions.subject: Arithmetic
questions.question: 10 men can complete a piece of work in 15 days and 15 women can complete the same work in 12 days. If all the 10 men and 15 women work together, in how many days will the work get completed?
questions.explanation: 10 men's 1-day work = 1/15. 15 women's 1-day work = 1/12. Together 1-day work = 1/15 + 1/12 = 9/60 = 3/20. Total time required = 20/3 = 6 2/3 days.

questions.subject: Arithmetic
questions.question: The ratio between the speeds of two trains is 7:8. If the second train runs 400 kms in 4 hrs, then the speed of the first train is
questions.explanation: Speed of 2nd train = 400 / 4 = 100 km/hr. Since ratio is 7 : 8, Speed of 1st train = (7 / 8) × 100 = 87.5 km/hr.

questions.question: The prime numbers dividing 143 and leaving a remainder of 3 in each case are
questions.explanation: 143 - 3 = 140. Divisors must be greater than remainder 3. Prime factorization of 140 = 2² × 5 × 7. The prime divisors > 3 are 5 and 7.

questions.subject: Arithmetic
questions.question: At what time between 9 and 10 o'clock will the hands of a watch be together?
questions.explanation: At 9 o'clock, the minute hand is 45 minute spaces behind. Time taken to gain 45 spaces = 45 × (12/11) = 540/11 = 49 1/11 min past 9.

questions.subject: Arithmetic
questions.question: At what rate per cent of simple interest will a sum of money double itself in 12 years?
questions.explanation: If sum doubles, SI = Principal. R = (100 × SI)/(P × T) = (100 × 1)/(1 × 12) = 25/3 = 8 1/3% per annum.

questions.subject: Arithmetic
questions.question: A motor car starts with speed of 70 km/hr with its speed increasing every two hours by 10 km/hr. In how many hours will it cover 345 kms?
questions.explanation: First 2 hrs: 70 × 2 = 140 km. Next 2 hrs at 80 km/hr: 80 × 2 = 160 km. Total in 4 hrs = 300 km. Remaining 45 km at 90 km/hr takes 45/90 = 0.5 hr. Total time = 4.5 hrs (4 1/2 hrs).
questions.bengaliHint: সময় ও দূরত্ব: প্রথম ৪ ঘণ্টায় দূরত্ব = ১৪০ + ১৬০ = ৩০০ কিমি। বাকি ৪৫ কিমি যেতে সময় = ৪৫/৯০ = ১/২ ঘণ্টা। মোট সময় = ৪ ১/২ ঘণ্টা।

questions.question: A shopkeeper has a certain number of eggs of which 5% are found to be broken. He sells 93% of the remainder and still has 266 eggs left. How many eggs did he originally have?
